svg.title: Quotation answer and order lifecycle with stock holds
svg.desc: An approved and sent quotation holds its stock. The customer can accept it by typing a fixed phrase or pressing the Telegram button, or decline it. Acceptance creates a pending order and keeps the hold. Decline, expiry and a new revision release the hold. Staff confirm the pending order, which moves the stock out of on-hand, or cancel it, which releases the hold. A confirmed order can still be cancelled and its stock returns. A new customer request while the order is pending is parked for staff with one fixed notice; after the order is confirmed the next request starts a new quotation and the accepted one stays for history.
